channel.title: With Raspberry Pi
channel.description: Master Raspberry Pi with our comprehensive tutorials covering setup, programming, troubleshooting, and advanced projects. Perfect for beginners and experts alike.

item.title: Android Architecture Map
item.description: Explore AOSP and AAOS architecture in an interactive map. Select Android framework, Binder, HAL, vendor, kernel, and Car Service components.

item.title: AOSP & AAOS on Raspberry Pi
item.description: Build AOSP Android 16 and explore Android Automotive OS on Raspberry Pi 4 or Pi 5. Choose tablet, TV, or car targets and learn the platform architecture.

item.title: AOSP Architecture Explained: Apps, Binder, HAL, and Kernel
item.description: Understand AOSP architecture from apps to the Linux kernel. Learn System Server, Binder and AIDL, ART, HALs, Treble partitions, and AAOS Car Service.

item.title: Build AOSP Android 16 for Raspberry Pi 4 and Pi 5
item.description: Build AOSP Android 16 for Raspberry Pi 4 or Pi 5 with the Raspberry Vanilla local manifest. Select tablet, TV, or AAOS products and create a test image safely.

item.title: Run Android Automotive OS on Raspberry Pi
item.description: Run the Android Automotive OS AOSP car product on Raspberry Pi 4 or Pi 5 for safe platform learning. Build, boot, inspect logs, and understand VHAL boundaries.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Headless Setup Troubleshooter
item.description: Diagnose Raspberry Pi headless setup failures by symptom. Get safe checks for boot, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, mDNS, SSH refused, timeout, keys, and USB Gadget Mode.

item.title: Fix Google Chrome ARM64 Errors on Raspberry Pi
item.description: Fix Google Chrome ARM64 installation and startup errors on Raspberry Pi OS. Diagnose 404 downloads, armhf mismatch, APT dependencies, profiles, and Sync.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Chrome ARM64 vs Chromium vs Firefox Benchmark
item.description: Compare Google Chrome ARM64, Chromium, and Firefox on Raspberry Pi with repeatable startup, memory, page-load, video, power, temperature, and Sync tests.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Power Consumption and Cost Calculator
item.description: Calculate Raspberry Pi electricity use and cost from measured idle/load watts, operating hours, energy rate, device count, and optional carbon intensity.

item.title: Raspberry Pi TPM2 LUKS2 Auto-Unlock with systemd-cryptenroll
item.description: Test TPM2-backed LUKS2 auto-unlock on Raspberry Pi safely with systemd-cryptenroll, an encrypted data partition, recovery key, crypttab, and failure drills.

item.title: Raspberry Pi 5 TPM 2.0 Module Selection Guide
item.description: Choose a TPM 2.0 module for Raspberry Pi 5 by voltage, SPI or I2C interface, Linux driver, Device Tree support, form factor, provisioning, and recovery needs.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Memory Pressure, ZRAM, and OOM Diagnosis
item.description: Diagnose Raspberry Pi memory pressure, swap stalls, and OOM kills with PSI, vmstat, cgroups, and ZRAM metrics before changing swap or buying more RAM.

item.title: Raspberry Pi OS Performance Optimization 2026
item.description: Optimize Raspberry Pi OS Trixie safely. Choose ZRAM, OverlayFS, boot, storage, power, and thermal changes from measurements instead of copied tweaks.

item.title: Raspberry Pi SD Card Wear Reduction Guide
item.description: Reduce Raspberry Pi SD card writes by finding write-heavy processes, limiting logs, moving volatile data, and choosing OverlayFS without losing required data.

item.title: AArch64 ADRP, ADD, and LDR: Address Loading on Raspberry Pi
item.description: Understand AArch64 ADRP, ADD, LDR literal, GOT, and PC-relative address loading on Raspberry Pi. Includes GNU assembly, relocations, objdump, and GDB checks.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Headless and Networking Guide 2026
item.description: Choose the best Raspberry Pi headless connection in 2026. Compare Wi-Fi, Ethernet, USB Gadget, SSH, Connect, Tailscale, VNC, static IP, and recovery paths.

item.title: Raspberry Pi USB Gadget Mode 2026: SSH over USB
item.description: Set up Raspberry Pi USB Gadget Mode on Trixie for SSH over one USB cable. Covers Imager, rpi-usb-gadget, supported models, Windows, macOS, Linux, and fixes.

item.title: Compute Module 5 Setup: eMMC, NVMe, and IO Board Guide
item.description: Set up Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 with the IO Board. Compare Lite and eMMC models, expose storage with rpiboot, flash, configure NVMe, and test thermals.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Benchmark Methodology: Power, Temperature, Storage, Network, and AI
item.description: Benchmark Pi power, temperature, boot time, storage, network, and AI reproducibly. Capture hardware and software context, raw data, and failure states.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Connect Remote Updates: Complete Trixie Guide
item.description: Deploy Raspberry Pi Connect remote updates on Trixie. Build signed-checksum script artefacts, test staged rollouts, inspect OTA logs, and plan A/B recovery.
